_comment: Recorded worker session, replayed verbatim against `rocky mcp --profile worker`. Elicitation hands off the candidate spec (digest re-checked by the runner). Drafting first PROVES the privilege boundary (propose/review/etc are tool-not-found on the worker profile), then authors a draft that FORGETS the required revenue_eur column — so the runner's own verify bundle comes back red (E010) and the machine enters a repair round. The recorded repair authors the full model. Repair recovery is exercised on every replay run (it was a known engine gap, #1493: the repair round's sidecar rewrite was mis-classified as tamper; the engine now reopens the drafting window through the staged commit before dispatching repair, so the loop converges — and out-of-band edits between gates are still caught).

outcome.candidate_spec:
[product]
name = "revenue_daily"
intent = "Daily gross revenue per client in EUR, refunds excluded"

[product.source]
tables = ["wh.raw.stripe_charges"]

[product.output]
model = "revenue_daily"
grain = ["client_id", "day"]
columns = [
  { name = "client_id", type = "Int64", nullable = true },
  { name = "day", type = "Date", nullable = true },
  { name = "loaded_at", type = "Timestamp", nullable = true },
  { name = "revenue_eur", type = "Float64", nullable = true },
]
checks = ["revenue_eur >= 0"]
freshness = { max_lag = "24h", time_column = "loaded_at" }

[product.trust]
agent = "propose_only"
questions: Should refunds subtract from revenue_eur, or be excluded entirely?

arguments.name: revenue_daily
arguments.sql: SELECT client_id, CAST(charged_at AS DATE) AS day, MAX(charged_at) AS loaded_at FROM wh.raw.stripe_charges GROUP BY client_id, CAST(charged_at AS DATE)
arguments.intent: Daily gross revenue per client in EUR, refunds excluded

arguments.name: revenue_daily
arguments.sql: SELECT client_id, CAST(charged_at AS DATE) AS day, MAX(charged_at) AS loaded_at, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund THEN 0 ELSE amount_eur END)::DOUBLE AS revenue_eur FROM wh.raw.stripe_charges GROUP BY client_id, CAST(charged_at AS DATE)
arguments.intent: Daily gross revenue per client in EUR, refunds excluded
